decisions.reason: Offshore vessel management is a strategic growth area and flagship service aligned with the firm's renewable and offshore expansion.
Crew and corporate travel management complements the core crew service and remains valuable despite being less central than flagship offerings.
The online vessel information portal is a flagship digital service that supports the firm's move toward smarter, more transparent operations.
The mobile vessel performance app supports efficiency and sustainability goals and is likely retained as part of the digital service suite.
